column1: # AI4SE advisor board — roster (EXAMPLE). Copy it OUTSIDE any repository (it holds names)
# One line per repository: a learner with CalcApp and a mini-project has two lines with the same id.
#   id       the learner's course identifier (v + number
#   name     for the trainer only; shown on the private page
#   repo     GitHub address (https://github.com/owner/name or owner/name) or a local folder
#   project  optional label (default: the repository name)
#   url      optional live address; read from .gse/deploy.json when it is committed
